title: ACCOUNTS & OPERATIONS ASSISTANT
description:
ACCOUNTS & OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

Salary: 29,000 to 33,000 p/a
Hours: Monday to Thursday 9:00am - 5:00pm, Friday 9:00am - 4:30pm
Job Type: Full Time
Sector: Accounts / Administration / Operations

THE ROLE

PPM Recruitment are currently recruiting for an Accounts & Operations Assistant to join a specialist tailoring and clothing business based in Worcester.

This is a varied, hands-on role combining accounts, finance administration and general operational support. The successful candidate will work closely with the Directors and liaise with Sales, Purchasing and Warehouse teams to ensure accounts and business processes are accurate and completed efficiently.

Accounts will make up approximately 60-70% of the role, with the remaining time focused on operational and administrative support.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - ACCOUNTS
- Process and post purchase invoices and expenses using Dext and Xero
- Check invoice coding and supporting documentation
- Raise and post sales invoices and credit notes
- Allocate customer receipts and supplier payments
- Carry out bank reconciliations
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate discrepancies
- Assist with credit control and customer account queries
- Prepare supplier payment runs for approval
- Process mileage claims
- Assist with payroll information and payroll reconciliations
- Reconcile wages, PAYE, pensions and other control accounts
- Assist with VAT preparation and reconciliations
- Help maintain accurate and reconciled balance sheet accounts
- Assist with month-end processes, including accruals, prepayments and journals
- Maintain accurate financial records and supporting documentation

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - OPERATIONS & ADMINISTRATION
- Provide practical administrative support across the business
- Assist with customer, supplier, stock and invoice queries
- Liaise with Sales, Purchasing and Warehouse teams to resolve discrepancies
- Maintain accurate customer, supplier and product information
- Assist with general office administration and ad-hoc projects
- Follow up outstanding tasks and ensure issues are resolved
- Identify discrepancies or incomplete information and take ownership of resolving them

THE PERSON

The ideal candidate will have previous experience as an Accounts Assistant, Bookkeeper, Finance Administrator or similar role, preferably within a small or medium-sized business.

You should be comfortable working in a hands-on environment and processing accounts transactions yourself.

Key skills and experience:
- Good practical bookkeeping knowledge
- Strong attention to detail
- Experience with bank and supplier reconciliations
- Good understanding of balance sheet reconciliations
- Excellent organisation and time-management skills
- Ability to investigate discrepancies and follow queries through to completion
- Good spreadsheet and general IT skills
- Xero experience highly desirable
- Dext experience advantageous, but training can be provided
- Reliable, practical and willing to support other areas of the business when required
- Good communication skills and a professional approach

Apply today with your CV or call on (phone number removed) and speak to Karina

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
salary_text: £33000 - £35000 per year (Bonus & Death in service x4 salary)
description:
Digital Marketing Coordinator

We're recruiting for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to join an established and growing FMCG business based in Worcestershire. This is a varied role offering the opportunity to take ownership of the company's digital presence while supporting wider marketing and brand activity.

The Role

As Digital Marketing Coordinator, you'll take day-to-day ownership of the company website and help develop its digital presence across SEO, AEO, email marketing and performance reporting.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing and developing the company website, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and up to date.
- Creating and updating WordPress pages, news articles and landing pages.
- Managing ongoing SEO activity and identifying opportunities to improve organic search performance.
- Developing the company's approach to AEO and AI search visibility.
- Monitoring website performance through Google Analytics and Google Search Console.
- Planning, creating and delivering customer email campaigns and newsletters through Mailchimp.
- Supporting social media activity across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and other relevant channels.
- Writing engaging copy for websites, social media, newsletters, campaigns and wider marketing materials.
- Supporting digital campaigns, product launches, brand activity, presentations and company communications.
- Coordinating with external agencies, designers, printers and other suppliers.
- Producing monthly reporting across website, SEO, email and social activity, using insights to recommend improvements.

About You

We're looking for someone with previous experience in digital marketing or a broader marketing role, who is proactive, commercially minded and comfortable taking ownership.

You'll ideally have:
- Hands on experience managing and updating websites using WordPress or another CMS.
- Good working knowledge of SEO and digital content optimisation.
- Strong copywriting and written communication skills.
- Experience using Mailchimp or a similar email marketing platform.
- Confidence working with analytics and campaign data to understand performance and identify opportunities.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small marketing team.
- Experience within FMCG, food, fresh produce, agriculture, wholesale or another B2 B environment would also be beneficial.

A full UK driving licence and access to a car is essential for occasional site, supplier and event visits.

What's on Offer?

Salary circa 35,000

Private medical insurance

Life assurance of up to 4x salary

28 days' holiday, including bank holidays

title: Wedding & Events Co-ordinator
description:
Wedding & Events Co-ordinator

Worcestershire

Permanent

£28,000 - £35,000 + Bonus

An exceptional opportunity has arisen for an ambitious, organised and customer-focused Wedding & Events Coordinator to join a highly respected and established events and hospitality business based in Worcestershire.

This is far more than a traditional events role. It offers the chance to be involved in the planning, coordination and delivery of a diverse range of memorable experiences, from luxury weddings and private celebrations to corporate events and bespoke catering functions.

Working within a passionate and supportive team, you will play a pivotal role in bringing clients' visions to life, guiding them through every stage of their journey from initial enquiry and venue viewing through to seamless event execution. You'll be responsible for creating unforgettable experiences, building lasting relationships with clients and suppliers, and ensuring every event is delivered to the highest possible standard.

No two days are the same. One day you could be conducting venue tours with prospective couples, the next coordinating suppliers, overseeing event set-ups, creating engaging social media content, or managing the smooth delivery of a stunning wedding or large-scale private function. This is a hands-on role that combines event planning, client relationship management, operational coordination, hospitality and marketing, making it an ideal opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced and rewarding environment.

The business operates across a seven-day events schedule, meaning flexibility is essential. In return, you'll join a successful and growing organisation known for delivering exceptional customer experiences, offering genuine career development opportunities, a collaborative team culture and the chance to be part of some truly special occasions.

Working Hours
- 5-day rota working pattern
- Typically 9-10 days off per month
- Frequent weekend working required
- Event days generally start between 9am and 10am and finish in the early evening
- Occasional evening and late-night event cover may be required
- Additional support may be required during peak wedding season

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £28,000 - £35,000 depending on experience
- Paid overtime
- Performance-related bonuses
- Company pension scheme
- Free on-site parking
- Company laptop provided
- Meals provided during shifts where applicable
- Company social events
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Genuine long-term career opportunity within a growing business

Key Responsibilities
- Manage wedding and event enquiries from initial contact through to final planning meetings
- Conduct venue show-rounds and convert enquiries into bookings
- Liaise with suppliers including florists, DJs, entertainers and venue partners
- Coordinate all event logistics and client requirements
- Oversee event setup, including room layouts, décor and equipment
- Manage and support operational staff during events
- Ensure venue presentation and cleanliness standards are maintained
- Create engaging marketing content for social media and online platforms
- Support catering operations, including order processing and event logistics
- Assist with promotional activities and business development initiatives

About You

The ideal candidate will possess:
- Previous experience within weddings, events, hospitality or venue management
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent communication and customer service abilities
- Experience coordinating multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive and adaptable attitude
- Confidence working independently and as part of a team
- Knowledge of social media platforms, including Instagram and TikTok
- Ability to remain calm under pressure during busy event periods

Requirements
- Experience within hospitality, events or a customer-facing environment
- Full driving licence and access to a vehicle due to the rural location
- Flexibility to work weekends as part of a rota
- Availability during peak wedding and events seasons

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about creating memorable experiences and developing a long-term career within the events and hospitality industry.

Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.

Thank you for taking the time to apply.

For more information on this position, please contact James Randall at Four Squared Recruitment.

title: Medical Receptionist / Care navigator
description: As a valued member of our team is reducing their hours, an exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced primary care professional to join our friendly and supportive practice. This varied role brings together care navigation and scanning/coding duties. The successful applicant will provide a professional and welcoming first point of contact, guiding patients to the most appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, timely, and effective manner. They will also be responsible for the accurate processing, scanning, and coding of clinical documentation, ensuring attention to detail and high standards of data quality. Ideally, candidates will have previous experience within primary care, strong leadership qualities, and excellent communication skills. The ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and thrive in a busy team environment is essential. Strong IT skills are also required to support the demands of the role. Reception Duties Provide an effective and efficient reception service to patients and visitors at the practice. Open the premises at the start of the day, ensuring all necessary checks and preparations are completed to receive patients. Secure the building at the end of the day, ensuring all areas are fully secured. Handle general enquiries and process appointment requests from patients via phone, online, or in person, updating the EMIS clinical system accordingly. Process repeat prescription requests. Receive and distribute both internal and external mail and documentation. Ensure accurate and timely logging of messages for clinicians regarding emergency appointment requests and home visits. Coordinate with third-party agencies to arrange patient care as directed by GP's. Maintain and accurately enter data into the practices computer system and patients' electronic records, which may include scanning and coding clinical information in line with practice protocols. Reception and Administrative Duties: Leadership: Ensure the delivery of high-quality patient services within a safe and efficient work environment by providing effective support to clinicians and staff. Maintain a calm and professional reception area, addressing disruptive behaviours politely and safely, and escalating to management when necessary.Stay informed of any updates or changes in practice guidance and team procedures. Assist in training new reception team members. Front Desk: Be the first point of contact for patients, projecting a positive and friendly image to patients and visitors. Assist with any queries, whether in person, over the phone, or online. Handle patient enquiries efficiently and courteously. Manage the flow of patients arriving at the reception for appointments or inquiries. Process payments and issue receipts for non-NHS services. Ensure the reception area, noticeboards, and leaflet dispensers are clean, tidy, and free from obstructions. Registrations and Appointments: Register new patients and schedule appointments. Assist with care navigation, helping patients find the most appropriate clinician or service, both within and outside the practice. (Training will be provided.) Monitor incoming E-Consult messages, scheduling appropriate appointments or directing them to appropriate member of staff. Accurately record and assess requests for emergency appointments / home visits based on urgency, following practice protocols. Once trained, act as a chaperone for patients during GP appointments when requested. Arrange interpreting services for patients as needed. Communication: Answer incoming phone calls promptly and professionally, ensuring calls are documented and acted upon or redirected as appropriate. Coordinate with GPs, Nurses, and the clinical team to relay information, follow up on documentation, results, and appointments. Monitor the reception email account, actioning requests and escalating urgent matters to them to appropriate member of staff when necessary. Liaise with GP's and clinicians to forward concerns, follow up on samples, letters, prescriptions, and other paperwork. Prescriptions and Certificates: Assist with processing prescriptions and addressing patient queries related to prescriptions. Handle Cremation Forms and Death Certificates, notifying relevant departments and accurately documenting details of the passing. Data Handling: Timely action EMIS tasks and DOCMAN workflow. Update and maintain patient records through accurate data entry. Manage incoming correspondence via post and electronically. Miscellaneous: Safely accept and record vaccine/medication deliveries, ensuring correct storage and informing relevant departments. Open and lock practice premises as needed, ensuring security protocols are followed. General Duties: Collaborate professionally with colleagues at Albany House Surgery, fostering strong working relationships. Contribute to the development of services, including improving processes, templates, and principles. Participate in any required statutory, mandatory, or additional training and development programs.

description: Full time role available in the MSK physiotherapy admin team. We are looking for a highly motivated, methodical, and organised individual to join our team of physiotherapy admin staff. The job is varied and busy, working across two sites in Worcester and Droitwich. Flexibility and negotiation to choose a main base will be given to the successful candidate. Full training will be given to the successful applicant for all in house processes and IT packages. You will work as part of a team in each base and share additional admin duties between you. This role is face to face providing some front of house duties and so it is not suitable for working from home. The applicant will be expected to have great people skills, be a confident communicator and have sound basic IT skills. We pride ourselves in providing outstanding care to patients across Herefordshire and Worcestershire and will offer you full support to achieve this. Full training is provided. If you would like to discuss informally if this is the right role for you, get in touch with Recruiting Manager. Applicants must read the attached guidance notes before submitting your application for full understanding of Trust requirements. The role involves data input and booking appointments on our patient clinical notes system, customer service through taking phone calls, handling patient queries, ordering equipment as well as organising clinics and other general admin duties. The post holder will Behave consistently with the values and beliefs of the organisation and promotes these on day to day basis. Act as a role model to colleagues, always seeking to maintain the highest standards of professionalism. Use their initiative and take responsibility for themselves and the quality of their work and the service provides they provide to patients Provide effective and efficient administrative support to the department. Undertake administration duties that are specific to the role. Provide administrative support as required, e.g. typing, data inputting, filing, scanning/copying and telefaxing, in line with Trust Policies and Procedures. Answer/deal with both face-to-face and telephone enquiries. Deal with incoming and outgoing post. Undertake reception duties, if and when required, to cover for staff absences. For full details of the duties and criteria for the role please refer to the job description and person specification attached.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: St Johns House Medical Centre has an exciting opportunity for a new team member to join our established, friendly and dedicated hard working team. We are a large practice, working from purpose-built modern premises in St Johns. We are looking for a flexible, hard working and reliable person, who enjoys contact with the general public and is able to offer excellent communication and customer service skills. It is a varied and interesting role, covering medical reception and administrative duties. Ideally you should have experience of working as a receptionist, within a healthcare setting and be educated to GCSE level or equivalent . However, full training will be given. The position is for 29 hours (PT) per week with set days and set hours Monday to Friday is detailed below: Monday: 8:00-17:00 Tuesday: 13:00-17:00 Wednesday: 14:30-18:30 Thursday: 13:00-17:00 Friday: 8:00-17:00 Monday & Friday to include a 30 minute unpaid lunch break. If you would like an informal discussion about the roles, please contact Practice Manager Deb Gregory on 01905 740006. Previously applicants need not apply. The role of Medical Receptionist includes answering the telephone, actioning online triage requests and speaking with patients face to face to assist patients with queries. As a practice we use a care navigation system to ensure we guide patients to the correct service at the first contact. You will work with a team and rotate duties either in the call centre or on the main reception desk. Daily duties such as: Booking appointments face to face, over the phone or via online triage, including signposting to ensure the patient is booked with the right person, in the right place at the right time. Receiving and recording requests for home visits, district nurse visits, telephone consultations and taking messages. Helping to assist with general enquiries. Answer incoming calls in a timely manner as per practice protocol. Ensuring everything is set up for the day. The above list of duties is not exhaustive and may be subject to change as deemed necessary Full training will be given. Job Responsibilities: Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and any other visitors to the practice. To have a thorough knowledge of appointment procedures and adapt to changes. Deal with all general enquiries, explain procedures and make new and follow-up appointments. Using your own judgement and communication skills, ensure that patients requiring urgent medical attention are offered appropriate and timely appointments. Explain practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover, and ensure procedures are completed. Receive and make telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Accept requests for home visits according to practice procedures. Action repeat prescription requests as required and within practice procedures. Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non General Medical Services) services, accept payment and issue receipts. Enter patient information on to the computer as required. Patient notes and correspondence: Retrieve and re-file records as required, ensuring strict alphabetical order is adhered to Ensure correspondence, reports, results etc. are filed promptly and in the correct records, ensuring that all recent correspondence is available when patients are seen. Ensure records are kept in good repair, with all necessary information on the outside cover clearly visible. Premises: Make all necessary preparations to receive patients. Carry out end of day procedures as listed. Ensure that all new patients are registered onto the computer system promptly and accurately Undertake any other additional duties appropriate to the post as requested by the partners or the practice manager. Administration Tasks: To carry out administration tasks as per the receptionists rota.
